description: Pinch analysis (minimum utilities, pinch temperatures, composite curves, grand composite curve) and heat exchanger network design by manual tick-off heuristic

INPUT.description: Process streams and design parameters. Hot*/Cld* streams: {'value': [Tin, Tout, MCp], 'unit': 'kW/C'}, e.g. {'Hot1': {'value': [220, 60, 22], 'unit': 'kW/C'}, 'Cld1': {'value': [50, 210, 20], 'unit': 'kW/C'}}. All stream MCp units must match. Required: 'Tmin': {'value': 20, 'unit': 'C'} (minimum approach temperature) and 'U': {'value': 0.5, 'unit': 'kW/m2-C'} (overall heat transfer coefficient). Stream temperatures use the Tmin unit.

OUTPUT.description: Optional list of output names. Default: all of T_pinch, T_hot_pinch, T_cld_pinch, Q_hot_min_utility, Q_cld_min_utility, T_hot_composite, Q_hot_composite, T_cld_composite, Q_cld_composite, T_gcc, Q_gcc. The NETWORK result is always returned.

name: PINCHMANUAL
